appearance.loadFailed: Could not load the configuration. Close and reopen.
appearance.title: Customize {name}
appearance.subtitle: The appearance is saved for this kiosk on all its screens.
appearance.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
appearance.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Images are resized automatically and stored in Keirost.
appearance.soundHint: On the kiosk screen, press “Enable sound” once to allow alerts.
appearance.darkPanelHint: The dark panel keeps text readable over any background.
appearance.saved: Appearance saved. The kiosk will receive it within a minute; reload its screen to see it now.

firmware.incompatible: Firmware not compatible with this reader.
firmware.badFormat: The published version does not have the expected format.
firmware.badDownload: The download is incomplete or corrupted. Try again.
firmware.connecting: Connecting to the ESP32. If it takes long, hold BOOT until writing starts.
firmware.onlyEsp32: This firmware only supports ESP32 DevKit V1.
firmware.checkingLayout: Checking that the configuration can be preserved…
firmware.layoutMismatch: This board's memory layout is different. Nothing has been written or erased.
firmware.installing: Installing. Do not unplug the USB cable.
firmware.notConfirmed: Writing finished, but the new version's startup was not confirmed. Restart and check the reader.

firmwareUpdate.stateFailed: Could not check the reader status. Press “Check again”.
firmwareUpdate.githubFailed: Could not reach GitHub. Check the connection and reopen.

wifi.noState: The Wi-Fi update cannot be checked until the reader status is recovered.
wifi.inactive: Activate the reader to update it over Wi-Fi.
wifi.noVersion: Waiting for the reader to report its version over Wi-Fi. Leave it on and connected; it can take up to a minute. If it still does not appear, check its connection to Keirost. Versions 0.2.x need a USB update first.
wifi.pending: There is an update pending confirmation.
wifi.upToDate: You already have the latest version. The Wi-Fi update will be enabled when a new version is published.

firmwareUpdate.title: Update {name}
firmwareUpdate.subtitle: Official OpenFactu/keirots releases
firmwareUpdate.keepsConfig: The Wi-Fi configuration, certificate and token are kept. During installation the reader will not be available for clocking in.
firmwareUpdate.noContact: No recent contact with the reader. Check that it has power and Wi-Fi and can reach Keirost. If you run Keirost on this computer, it must stay on and not sleep.
firmwareUpdate.usbHint: USB: connect the reader and close the Arduino monitor. You need desktop Chrome or Edge. To enable Wi-Fi on 0.2.x versions, update via USB first.
firmwareUpdate.pendingVersion: Version {version} pending confirmation from the reader.
firmwareUpdate.pendingNoContact: The request is saved, but the reader has not confirmed it. Waiting does not mean it is downloading or installing.
firmwareUpdate.pendingHint: The reader checks for updates every minute. Keep it powered and connected to Keirost until it confirms the new version.
firmwareUpdate.cancelHint: Cancelling does not interrupt an installation that has already started.
firmwareUpdate.failed: The reader could not install the version. It keeps the previous one; check the connection and try again.

kioskId.confirmFailed: Could not confirm. Retry the same action.
kioskId.closeFailed: Could not close. Wait for the identification to expire.

kioskImage.invalid: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
kioskImage.tooComplex: The image is too complex. Try a smaller one.

kioskMode.defaultWelcome: Hold your card to the reader
kioskMode.identifyHint: Identify yourself to record your clock-in, clock-out or break.
kioskMode.notConfiguredHint: Open the link you will find in your company's kiosk management.
kioskMode.choose: Choose what you want to record.
kioskMode.timerAria: {n} seconds left to choose the time entry
kioskMode.scanQrHint: Hold up your personal QR, on your phone or on paper.

kiosks.regenMessage: Regenerate the token? The kiosk will need to be set up again.
kiosks.title: Clock-in kiosks
kiosks.subtitle: Shared terminals to clock in with a PIN, card or personal QR.
kiosks.footerHint: Open the kiosk link on the terminal. Employees can identify themselves with their PIN, personal QR or a card read by a linked reader, and choose the action on screen.

planning.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time
planning.secondEndAfterStart: Second segment: the end time must be after the start
planning.confirmCancel: Cancel this shift? (it stays in history, struck through)
planning.title: Planning
planning.overlapsNeedsSub: Overlaps a shift and requires a substitute
planning.howText: click an empty cell → create a shift. Click a shift → edit / cancel / delete. Hover a cell with a shift → "+ split" to add a second segment (split shift).
planning.legendIncident: Incident (affects payroll or requires a substitute)
planning.legendOverlap: Overlaps a shift and requires a substitute → handled in Incidents
planning.noTemplates: No templates. Create one in Shift templates.
planning.editingOneAfter: . The other segment is a separate shift: close this and click it in the planning.

errors.notAllowed: Allow camera access in the browser and try again.
errors.notFound: No camera available. Connect a camera or use your PIN.
errors.notReadable: The camera is busy or not responding. Close other applications using it.
errors.generic: Could not start the camera. Try again or use your PIN.
errors.insecure: The browser needs a secure connection to open the camera. Open the kiosk over HTTPS or use your PIN.
errors.disconnected: The camera has been disconnected. Connect it and try again.

qr.notTimeclockQr: That QR is not a clock-in QR. Show your personal QR.
qr.videoAria: Camera view to read your QR
qr.allowPrompt: If the browser shows a prompt, allow camera access.
qr.allowWhenAsked: Allow access when the browser asks.
qr.placeQr: Place your QR inside the frame and hold it still. It will be read automatically.
qr.pinMeanwhile: You can also identify yourself with your PIN meanwhile.

readCard.waiting: Hold a card to the reader. If it is already resting on it, remove it and bring it close again. You have 30 seconds.
readCard.read: Card read. Press Save card to assign it to this employee.
readCard.hintSupported: Connect the reader to this computer via USB. Close its USB setup and the Arduino monitor. This read does not identify anyone at the kiosk.
readCard.hintUnsupported: To read via USB, open this screen in desktop Chrome or Edge over HTTPS. You can also enter the UID manually.

readers.title: Card readers
readers.subtitle: Connect a reader to a kiosk or use it as a standalone terminal.
readers.name: Name
readers.standaloneTitle: The action must be chosen on the reader
readers.standaloneHint: The device must let users select clock in, clock out or break, for example with buttons or a screen. Tapping the card does not automatically toggle between clock in and clock out.
readers.secretHint: Store this configuration on the reader. The token is only shown now.
readers.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the configuration and copy it.
readers.rotateMessage: You will need to configure the reader with the new token.

shiftPatterns.saveFirst: Save the pattern before assigning employees
shiftPatterns.title: Shift patterns
shiftPatterns.subtitle: Cyclic rotations applied to employees with different offsets. "Expanding" generates actual assignments per day.
shiftPatterns.quickFillHint: Choose a "brush" template and apply it with one click. You can also copy weeks.
shiftPatterns.applyWeekdaysTitle: Apply brush to Mon-Fri of this week
shiftPatterns.expandHint: Generates materialized assignments (actual shifts) in the range. It is idempotent: it first deletes those previously generated with this pattern in the same range.

shiftTemplates.title: Shift templates
shiftTemplates.subtitle: Each template defines a shift by actual hours (not fixed). They are used in patterns and assignments.
shiftTemplates.splitHint: Optional. If you define it, applying the template generates two shifts on the same day (morning + afternoon).

timeclock.title: Time entries
timeclock.noRecent: you have not clocked in during the last 31 days
timeclock.qrAlt: My personal QR to identify myself at the kiosk
timeclock.qrHint: Show this QR to the kiosk camera.
timeclock.emptyRange: No time entries in the range

usb.urlPlain: Use the Keirost HTTPS address, without paths or credentials.
usb.urlLocalhost: The reader needs a Keirost address reachable from its Wi-Fi; localhost points to the reader itself.
usb.urlTooLong: The server address is too long.
usb.urlHost: Use a domain or an IPv4 address reachable from the reader.
usb.ssidRequired: Enter the Wi-Fi network name (maximum 32 bytes).
usb.passwordRequired: Re-enter the Wi-Fi password or indicate that the network has no password.
usb.passwordLength: The Wi-Fi password must be between 8 and 63 bytes.
usb.certFormat: The installation certificate must be in PEM format (maximum 4 KB).

device.bootRequired: Hold BOOT on the ESP32 while saving. Do not press EN.
device.invalidConfig: The reader rejected the configuration. Check the network and the HTTPS address.
device.storageError: The reader could not save the configuration. Try again.
device.captureBusy: The reader is already reading a card. Cancel the previous read or wait 30 seconds.
device.captureInvalid: The read session is not valid. Press Read card again.

connect.noPort: No port selected. Select the CP2102 (COM8) row and press Connect.
connect.selectDenied: Chrome did not allow selecting the USB device. Check this page's serial port permission.
connect.openFailed: Chrome found the reader but cannot open the USB port. Close the Visual Studio serial monitor and any other tab connected to the reader.
connect.firmwareRequired: The reader responds, but it needs Keirost firmware 0.2 to be configured from this screen.
connect.noHandshake: The USB port is open, but the reader does not answer the handshake. Wait for it to boot and reconnect.

usb.disconnected: The reader has been disconnected. Connect it again.
usb.busy: Wait for the previous operation to finish.
usb.timeout: The reader is not responding. Check that it has the Keirost connection firmware and close the Arduino monitor.
usb.usbDisconnected: The USB device has been disconnected.
usb.updateForCapture: The reader software must be updated to Keirost 0.2.1 or later to read cards here.
usb.invalidCard: The reader returned an invalid card. Try again.
usb.invalidReply: The reader returned an invalid response. Try again.
usb.noCard: No card was read within 30 seconds. Try again.

states.unconfigured: Connected via USB. The configuration still needs to be saved.
states.releaseBoot: Configuration saved. Release BOOT so the reader can start.
states.ready: The reader has connected to Keirost and is ready.
states.awaitingConfirmation: Card sent. Confirm the action on the kiosk screen.
states.sending: Sending the identification to the kiosk…
states.retrying: The response was lost. The reader is retrying the same identification.
states.serverUnavailable: Cannot connect to Keirost. Check the address, the certificate and the connection.
states.unauthorized: Keirost refused access. Check that the reader is active and configure it again.
states.wrongMode: This firmware needs a reader linked to an active kiosk.
states.unknownCard: The card is not assigned to an active employee.
states.kioskBusyOrConflict: The screen is busy or the configuration has changed. Check the kiosk.
states.readingExpired: The response did not arrive in time. Check the kiosk before identifying again.
states.rateLimited: The platform asked to wait. The reader will respect that delay.
states.invalidResponse: The Keirost response is not compatible. Check the address and the server version.
states.startupError: The reader could not start the connection. Restart it and try again.
states.updatingFirmware: Installing the update. Do not disconnect the reader.
states.firmwareUpdateFailed: Could not install the update. The reader keeps the previous version.

usbSetup.statusFailed: Could not query the reader. If you unplugged the cable, plug it back in.
usbSetup.holdBootError: Hold BOOT while saving. Do not press EN.
usbSetup.title: Configure {name}
usbSetup.subtitle: Connect the reader to this computer. Afterwards it will work over Wi-Fi.
usbSetup.unsupported: Open Keirost in desktop Chrome or Edge over HTTPS (or localhost in development) to configure the reader via USB.
usbSetup.connectHint: Close the Arduino monitor if it is open and select the ESP32 connected via USB.
usbSetup.wifiHint: Use a 2.4 GHz network. The password is sent to the reader via USB and is not stored in Keirost.
usbSetup.serverUrlHint: It must be reachable from the reader's Wi-Fi. The company and device access are configured automatically.
usbSetup.rootCertHint: Leave it empty if Keirost uses a valid public certificate. Do not enter a private key.
usbSetup.tokenRenewHint: Saving will renew this reader's access; its previous configuration will stop working.
usbSetup.holdBootAfter: on the board while saving. Release it when “Configuration saved” appears.
usbSetup.saved: Configuration saved. Release BOOT and wait for the reader to connect to Keirost.
usbSetup.reenterPassword: Re-enter the Wi-Fi password to save the correction.
